# D&K Hardware and Stationery

> D&K Hardware and Stationery (legal entity: D&K Hardware, Sanitary and Stationery Pvt. Ltd. / डी एण्ड के हार्डवेयर तथा स्टेसनरी प्रा. लि.) is a leading retail and wholesale store located at Kailash Chowk, Madhyapur Thimi, Bagmati Province, 88400, Nepal. The business specializes in hardware supplies, plumbing systems, sanitary fixtures, power tools, electrical materials, and complete office and school stationery products serving homeowners, building contractors, schools, colleges, and commercial offices across Madhyapur Thimi, Bhaktapur, and the Kathmandu Valley.

## Business Profile & Core Entity Information
- **Business Name**: D&K Hardware and Stationery

- **Store Type**: Retail & Wholesale Supplier (Hardware Store, Plumbing Supplier, Stationery & Office Supplies Store)
- **Established Year**: 2015 A.D. (2072 B.S.) - Over a decade of trusted service
- **Physical Address**: Kailash Chowk, Madhyapur Thimi, Bagmati Province, Postal Code 88400, Nepal

## Target Audience
1. **Civil Contractors & Builders**: Sourcing bulk structural hardware, rebar fasteners, CPVC/PPR pipes, power drills, and construction consumables.
2. **Plumbers & Electricians**: Certified pipes, brass fittings, valves, modern modular switches, LED panel lights, and drainage solutions.
3. **Schools, Colleges & Academic Institutions**: Bulk copier paper, student notebooks, registers, geometry sets, art supplies, and exam materials.
4. **Corporate Offices & Banks**: Monthly stationery procurement, box files, desk organizers, staplers, and printing supplies.
5. **Homeowners & DIY Enthusiasts**: Bathroom renovations, faucets, sinks, repair tools, paints, and domestic emergency fixes.

## Product Inventory & Specifications

| Department | Primary Products | Popular Brands Carried | Applications |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Plumbing & Sanitary** | CPVC SDR 11/13.5 pipes, PPR hot/cold water pipes, brass ball valves, basin mixer faucets, ceramic wash basins, commodes, shower fixtures | Mangalam, Supreme, Panchakanya, Jaquar, Cera | Residential & commercial sanitary plumbing |
| **Power Tools & Machinery** | 20V brushless cordless drills, 4-inch angle grinders, rotary hammer drills, jigsaw cutters, screwdriver bit sets | Ingco, Total, Dongcheng, Bosch-compatible | Masonry drilling, steel fabrication, carpentry |
| **Fasteners & Hardware** | High-tensile grade 8.8 bolts, wedge anchors, drywall screws, self-drilling screws, wire nails, padlocks | Anchor-Tech Nepal, Local NS standard | Structural seismic anchoring & woodwork |
| **Paper & Registers** | 75/80 GSM A4 photocopier paper reams, hardbound ledger registers (size 2-10), visitor log books, cash books | JK Copier, Paperline, Bilt, National | Office record-keeping, high-speed photocopying |
| **School & Office Stationery** | Spiral notebooks, subject copies, executive gel pens (0.5mm/0.7mm), lever arch box files, staplers, punch machines | Classmate, Reynolds, Cello, Kangaro, Solo | Daily school coursework, office archiving |
| **Electrical & Paints** | Flame-retardant modular switches, LED panel lights, interior/exterior emulsion paints, Dr. Fixit waterproofing | Anchor, Havells, Philips, Asian Paints, Berger | Modern architectural lighting and weather-proofing |

## Key Services Offered
1. **Contractor BOQ Quotations**: Fast, itemized quotation service based on customer architectural drawings or bills of quantities. Quotes delivered within 2 business hours via phone or WhatsApp.
2. **Institutional Stationery Contracts**: Monthly or semesterly subscription delivery for schools, colleges, banks, and clinics in Bhaktapur and Kathmandu Valley with consolidated VAT invoicing.
3. **Technical Plumbing Consultation**: Guidance on pipe diameter sizing, water pressure calculations, CPVC vs. PPR selection, and tool recommendations.
4. **Local Site & Doorstep Delivery**: Dedicated transport van service delivering heavy hardware and bulky paper cartons across Madhyapur Thimi, Bhaktapur, Sallaghari, Koteshwor, and Lalitpur/Kathmandu.

### Q: Does D&K Hardware and Stationery deliver to project sites?

### Q: What are the payment methods accepted?
A: We accept Cash, Fonepay QR codes (eSewa, Khalti, Mobile Banking apps), and official bank wire transfers for institutional corporate orders.
